checks.name: tests/http/server.test.ts: real HTTP-level test of src/server.ts's OPERATIONS whitelist (closes prior critique gap)
checks.detail: This check directly answers the major finding in critique-integration-verification-report.json (unverifiable_acceptance): that no automated check exercised src/server.ts's request-routing/whitelist path, and that the prior report's own mutation test (removing "pow" from OPERATIONS) left all tests green. tests/http/server.test.ts now starts the real exported `requestListener` handler (via `createServer(requestListener).listen(0, ...)` on an ephemeral port, `src/server.ts`'s `listen()` call itself is guarded behind `isMainModule()` so it does not bind PORT during tests) and drives it with real `fetch()` calls: (1) POST /calculate {op:"pow",a:2,b:10} -> 200 {result:1024}, exercising `isOperation()` -> `OPERATIONS.has("pow")` -> `Calculator.pow` end-to-end over HTTP; (2) POST /calculate {op:"add",a:2,b:3} -> 200 {result:5}, confirming the refactor (exporting `requestListener`, guarding `listen()`) is behavior-preserving for a pre-existing op; (3) POST /calculate {op:"not-a-real-op",...} -> 400, confirming the whitelist still rejects unknown ops. Ran `mise exec -- npm test`: 3/3 tests in this file pass as part of the 18/18 total. I independently re-ran the exact mutation the prior critique used to prove the gap: temporarily edited `OPERATIONS = new Set<Operation>(["add","sub","mul","div","mod","pow"])` back to `["add","sub","mul","div","mod"]` (dropping "pow") and re-ran `npm test` twice -> now FAILS as expected: 'POST /calculate (real HTTP layer) > dispatches op:pow through the OPERATIONS whitelist and returns 200 {result}' -> AssertionError: expected 400 to be 200 (17/18 passed, 1 failed, exit code 1). This is the opposite of the prior report's finding (previously this exact mutation left 15/15 green). File was restored (`git diff --stat -- src/server.ts` afterward shows only the change's real, intended diff: 21 insertions / 5 deletions for the `requestListener` export + `isMainModule()` guard + "pow" addition to OPERATIONS) and the clean re-run confirmed green again (18/18). The gap the previous critique found is therefore now demonstrably covered by an automated, re-runnable, regression-sensitive check, not prose or source inspection.
